functions._after_booking_status:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._after_booking_status()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.status = 'checked_out' and old.status is distinct from 'checked_out' then
    insert into housekeeping_tasks (room_id, booking_id, kind, priority, created_by)
    select br.room_id, new.id, 'clean', 1, auth.uid()
    from booking_rooms br where br.booking_id = new.id and br.room_id is not null;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

cron_jobs.command:
select net.http_post(
    url := 'https://blossomsquare.online/api/jobs/messages',
    headers := jsonb_build_object('Authorization', 'Bearer ' || (select decrypted_secret from vault.decrypted_secrets where name = 'bsq_cron_secret'), 'Content-Type', 'application/json'),
    body := '{}'::jsonb,
    timeout_milliseconds := 55000)
